name: Streax Hair Serum Vitalized with Walnut Oil 115ml | Made in Bangladesh
description:
Streax Hair Serum Vitalized with Walnut Oil – 115ml
Made in Bangladesh

Nourish and revitalize your hair with the Streax Hair Serum Vitalized with Walnut Oil. Enriched with the natural goodness of walnut oil, this premium serum delivers smooth, frizz-free, and shiny hair while repairing and protecting damaged strands.

Key Features & Benefits:

Frizz-Free & Smooth: Tames unruly hair for a sleek, polished look.

Nourishes & Strengthens: Walnut oil provides essential nutrients to revitalize hair from root to tip.

Shiny & Healthy Hair: Seals smoothness into hair cuticles, giving hair a natural, glossy shine.

Repairs Damage: Smoothens rough and damaged strands, making hair soft and manageable.

Size: 115ml
Made in Bangladesh

Achieve soft, shiny, and healthy-looking hair effortlessly with Streax Hair Serum Vitalized with Walnut Oil.
